title: Invite friends
description: Invite a friend to register and verify with Skland. Both of you can earn permanent Agent credits.
unavailable: Referral activity could not be loaded. Please try again.
paused: The referral campaign is currently closed
pausedDescription: New referrals and rewards are paused. Credits already received remain available.
joinTitle: Register and authenticate with Skland to complete the invitation
joinDescription: Register through a friend’s link or enter their invitation code at signup. Verify your email and authenticate with Skland to receive {welcome} permanent credits. Your friend earns {points} credits per referral until they reach their limit.
eligibilityBody: New users can follow an invitation link or enter a code at signup, then verify their email and authenticate with Skland. The inviter is recorded at registration. Each website account and each Skland identity can receive the welcome reward only once.
limitsTitle: How many credits can I earn?
limitsBody: Under the current rules, inviters earn {points} permanent credits for each of up to {count} friends. Each eligible friend receives {welcome} permanent credits even when the inviter has reached the limit. Rewards use the rules in effect when issued. Settled amounts stay as recorded.
pauseTitle: What happens when the campaign closes?
pauseBody: New referrals and reward issuance are paused. Existing referral records are kept, and eligible pending rewards can continue when the campaign reopens. Credits already received remain available.
permanent: Rewards are added to your permanent credit balance
shareDescription: Copy your link and share it with friends who have not registered
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
qrDescription: Scan to register, verify your email and authenticate with Skland to qualify for referral rewards.
rewardTitle: A friend registers and authenticates with Skland
rewardDescription: You can earn rewards for up to {count} friends under the current rules. Each eligible friend receives {welcome} permanent credits.
empty: No referrals yet. Share your invitation link with a friend.
